answer: Because the atlas decay is applied at each close, the vault audit shows the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool hence watches its influence decay while paying the signal fee to keep them eligible. A juror that skips cases loses 34% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. A 201 account operation therefore ties up 10 million dollars of idle capital. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
